arabic text: ITNI THAKI HUWI HAI, BABA TERI SAKINA\nAB MAUT MANGTI HAI, BABA TERI SAKINA
english translation text: Your Sakina is so exhausted, Baba;\nyour Sakina now asks for death.

arabic text: SONA NASEEB HAI NA AATI HAI NEEND MUJHKO\nCHALEES DIN HUWE HAI, ZAINAB PHUPI SE PUCHO\nDIN RAAT JAAGTI HAI, BABA TERI SAKINA
english translation text: I have no chance to sleep, and sleep does not come.\nForty days have passed—ask Aunt Zainab.\nYour Sakina remains awake day and night, Baba.

arabic text: ZINDAAN KA ANDHERA AB HAI MERA MUQADAR\nPANI TO KYA HAWA BHI MUJHKO NAHI MAYASAR\nGHUT GHUT KE MAR RAHI HAI, BABA TERI SAKINA
english translation text: The prison's darkness is now my destiny.\nForget water—even air is unavailable to me.\nYour Sakina is dying breath by breath, Baba.

arabic text: IK WAQT AYA JAB ME BICHRI THI QAFELE SE\nPHIR MUJHKO QAFELA TAK LAYA THA SHIMR KAISE\nWHO SIRF JAANTI HAI, BABA TERI SAKINA
english translation text: Once I became separated from the caravan.\nHow Shimr brought me back to it—\nonly your Sakina knows, Baba.

arabic text: MAARE HAI TAZIYANE DURRE MUJHE LAGAYE\nTOOTI HAI PASLIYAAN BHI ITNE SITAM UTHAAYE\nAB JHUK KE CHAL RAHI HAI, BABA TERI SAKINA
english translation text: They struck me with lashes and whips.\nMy ribs too are broken from enduring so much cruelty.\nYour Sakina now walks bent over, Baba.

arabic text: DAADI KI TARHA MUJHKO LOTA DIYA HAI KHALI\nPHELA KE APNA DAMAN AUR BANKE IK SAWALI\nSAR MAANGTI RAHI HAI, BABA TERI SAKINA
english translation text: Like Grandmother, they returned me empty-handed.\nSpreading my garment and becoming a beggar,\nyour Sakina kept asking for your head, Baba.

arabic text: LE JAAWO MUJHKO BABA AAYI SADA YE MUHSIN\nAB HAR TARAF QAZA HAI JEENA NAHI HAI MUMKIN\nBAS SAANS LE RAHI HAI, BABA TERI SAKINA
english translation text: O Mohsin, a voice cried: Baba, take me away.\nDeath surrounds me everywhere; living is impossible.\nYour Sakina is merely breathing, Baba.
